assumptions.A3_terrestrial_span: Terrestrial inline amplifier (ILA/EDFA) count per link = ceil(L / S) - 1 with a per-scenario maximum span length S drawn from [70, 100] km; spans are equal length. ~80 km spans are a common planning assumption (e.g. GNPy example networks); not a standard.
assumptions.A4_submarine_repeater: Repeatered undersea segments: repeater count = ceil(L / S) - 1 with S drawn from [50, 90] km. Segments <= 350 km may be unrepeatered (festoon). Assumption, not a design.
assumptions.A6_terminals: Transponder / pluggable counts per site are synthetic and indicative only; they encode where traffic is terminated, not dimensioned capacity.
assumptions.A9_roadm_degree: ROADM degree equals the number of fibre links at the site.

note: Synthetic equipment assignment. Counts and types are modelling assumptions, not vendor designs; no GNPy simulation has been run for this scenario.
